item.title: Understanding and Preventing Sun Poisoning - Fight Like a Girl
item.description: Sun poisoning, also known as sunburn reaction or photodermatitis, is an extreme reaction to sunlight exposure. It can occur within a few hours or days of being in the sun, particularly if the skin is not adequately protected. Understanding the signs, symptoms, and treatments for sun poisoning is crucial for prevention and management. Signs and […]
